text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the first day of training for the Japanese Oaks, I hand Nishino Flower her new training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? This one is completely different…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: There's more stamina training, and the sessions are longer.
choice_data_list: It's to prepare you for the 2,400 meters.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Japanese Oaks is 800 meters longer than the Oka Sho. It'll take a lot of hard training to increase her endurance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I see… If I don't work really hard, I won't be able to finish the entire race…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay! Whatever training I need to do, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I want to show you some great results in the Japanese Oaks too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower is working as hard as she can to improve. In order to support her as her trainer, there's one thing I must make sure of.
choice_data_list: You have to tell me if things become too much to handle, okay?
You have to tell me if things become too much to handle, okay?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huff! Huff! Puff…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes… I-I'm fine… I just… need a break…
choice_data_list: (This is taking a greater toll on her than I thought…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: When running 2,400 meters, Nishino Flower's unable to use her greatest weapon: her fleet-footed speed. Maybe this distance is too much for her after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since it's her wish to run in the Japanese Oaks, we continue training every day, but…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Confusion detected. What is the matter, Flower?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: (This is Mihono Bourbon. I really couldn't ask for a kinder roommate.)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… It's my weight… H-hold on a second.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …I knew it. It's much lower than usual.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um… I think this scale's calibration is off.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: …Perhaps you should try another scale. I would test this one myself, but I am afraid it might break.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't believe my weight dropped so much and so quickly. I'm definitely eating enough…

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: You have been training very hard recently. It may be that this weight loss is the result of your body's inability to handle the burden.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ngh… Yeah, I kind of figured as much…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Should I stay quiet about it? Trainer will just worry… I mean, I'm already having problems because of my size…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: If I say anything, I might have to stop training, even though the race is just around the corner…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't even run properly in training yet. There's so much effort I can still put in.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: This is difficult to judge on an emotional basis. However, logically speaking, if you continue to overwork yourself, you may become unable to run at all.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I believe your best recourse is to report this to your trainer immediately and prioritize maintenance.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …You're right. If I don't say anything, I'll just cause Trainer even more trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Does this mean you will report your situation accordingly?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Yes, I will. Thanks for your advice, Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: So that's what's going on. Trainer, I…
choice_data_list: I'll put a rest period into your schedule.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay. I'm sorry…
choice_data_list: No need to apologize. Once you're rested, you'll be ready to go again.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: You think so? I really hope you're right.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With how intense her training is, I thought this might happen, so I made sure to plan ahead, just in case. But the thing that bothers me most is…
choice_data_list: Thank you for letting me know.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: …Honestly, I wasn't sure if I was going to. It's probably not a big deal, and I didn't want to worry you.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But Bourbon gave me the push I needed. I'm glad I told you now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The fact she hesitated to tell me. I need to become a trainer she feels comfortable relying on, or I'll never be able to fully support her.
choice_data_list: (I have to show her how dependable I can be!)

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? If I'm on break now, then does that mean…
choice_data_list: Yes, we won't be training today.
Yes, we won't be training today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Okay. Is there anything I can do besides training, then?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: The race is coming up, so I'd like to do whatever I can.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems she feels responsible for canceling our training session.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The best thing she can do now is to relax and get her weight back up. And in order for her to complete those two tasks…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-um, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can't do that!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I can cook my own meals! I'll do my best on that front, so please—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: But, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Oh, this miso-grilled mackerel looks really good…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ack! I didn't mean to say that out loud! Trainer, stooop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I'm at it, I also order a lot of side dishes and desserts I think she would like.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Phew… I'm stuffed…

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: It was delicious… I haven't taken the time to sit down and enjoy so many of my favorites in a while.
choice_data_list: Why don't we go get some tea now?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh? Can we really? But aren't you busy?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ooh!
choice_data_list: They serve lovely tea cakes too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Tea cakes?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: U-um, I'd love to see what it's like! Please lead the way!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nishino Flower seems more relaxed. It's great how she's always so earnest, but I think I should indulge her like this occasionally to keep the stress at bay.
